summary: passt networking, local caching server, Tesseract OCR, and GNOME Initial Setup bug fixes.

changes.note:
This release adds the following features:

 * Expand test coverage from 29% to 82%
 * Only allow the same client to request the same file after 1h

This release fixes the following bugs:

 * Correctly handle malformed key-value pairs when parsing the audit log
 * Escape all strings properly when building the HTML error page
 * Fix a memory leak when failing to resolve a local file on fallback
 * Handle invalid address strings when checking for loopback
 * Handle non-numeric addresses from the Avahi resolver
 * Only unpause the HTTP message in async response paths
 * Reject publish requests that do not include a basename
 * Validate that SHA-256 hashes only contain hex characters

changes.description: User-mode networking daemons for virtual machines and namespaces
changes.note:
- fix operation when we start with some standard streams closed: https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=215
- don't try to configure user mappings with --netns-only: https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=216
- use address passed via --gateway as source for inbound forwarding in containers, if it matches the scope of the destination: https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=217
- remove qrap(1): it was obsoleted a long time ago and presumably nobody is using it (not needed anymore since QEMU 7.2)
- avoid noise in system log when port forwarding fails for some ports, when ranges are given as exclusions: https://bugs.passt.top/show_bug.cgi?id=213
